description: This file defines a StatusUpdater class and related functions for managing and validating status and quantities of various document types in an ERP system, including handling over-allowance checks and status transitions.

classes.name: StatusUpdater
classes.description: A class for updating and validating the status of various documents, including handling over-allowance checks and quantity validations.

methods.name: validate_status
methods.description: Validates if a given status is within allowed options.

methods.name: update_prevdoc_status
methods.description: Updates the status of previous documents related to the current document.

methods.name: set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the document based on predefined status map and conditions.

methods.name: validate_qty
methods.description: Validates quantities at the row level, checking for over-delivery or over-billing.

methods.name: check_overflow_with_allowance
methods.description: Checks if the quantity or amount exceeds allowed over-delivery or over-billing allowances.

methods.name: limits_crossed_error
methods.description: Raises an error if limits are crossed.

methods.name: warn_about_bypassing_with_role
methods.description: Warns the user if they bypass over-allowance restrictions based on roles.

methods.name: update_qty
methods.description: Updates quantities or amounts at the row level.

methods.name: _update_children
methods.description: Updates quantities or amounts in child table records.

methods.name: _update_percent_field_in_targets
methods.description: Updates percent fields in parent transactions.

methods.name: _update_percent_field
methods.description: Updates a specific percent field in parent transaction.

methods.name: update_billing_status_for_zero_amount_refdoc
methods.description: Updates billing status for referenced documents with zero amount.

methods.name: update_billing_status
methods.description: Updates billing status based on billed quantities.

methods.name: get_allowance_for
methods.description: Returns over-delivery or over-billing allowance for an item, considering global settings.
